result.rationale: The diff shows `rss.items.each` calling `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and `TopicEmbed.import` per item, with `sidekiq_options retry: false` and no rescue/begin-ensure around the loop. Any single item raising (e.g., nil content, invalid URL, import error) aborts processing of all remaining feed items until the next hourly run, and the failure is silent. The mechanism is directly verifiable in the new poll_feed.rb code.
